transferConfigurations.title: Transfer configurations
transferConfigurations.description: Transfer destinations. The v3 API returns `transferConfigurations`; runtime/web singular `transferConfiguration` is accepted on input.

transferType.title: Transfertype
transferType.description: Call transfer mode: `cold` removes the agent as soon as the call is transferred and does not brief the operator; `warm` puts the customer on hold, briefs the operator with a conversation summary or static sentence, and then connects them. If the operator does not answer within 30 seconds, the agent resumes handling the customer.

transferMessageType.title: Transfermessagetype
transferMessageType.description: Operator briefing mode for `warm` transfers: `static` reads `warmTransferStaticSentence` verbatim to the operator, while `dynamic` uses `warmTransferPrompt` as instructions for the LLM to generate a conversation summary. Ignored for `cold` transfers.

warmTransferPrompt.title: Warmtransferprompt
warmTransferPrompt.description: Instructions for the LLM to generate a conversation summary for the operator during a `warm` transfer. Used only when `transferMessageType` is `dynamic`.

warmTransferStaticSentence.title: Warmtransferstaticsentence
warmTransferStaticSentence.description: Sentence read verbatim to the operator during a `warm` transfer. Used only when `transferMessageType` is `static`.

displayedCallerId.title: Displayedcallerid
displayedCallerId.description: Caller ID shown on the operator's phone for both `cold` and `warm` transfers. `agent` shows the vox agent's phone number; `user` shows the current customer's phone number.

transferTo.title: Transferto
transferTo.description: Phone number or SIP URI to transfer to. When `transferType` is `operator`, this is a display label shown to the operator, not a dialed destination.

transferCondition.title: Transfercondition
transferCondition.description: Condition under which this transfer destination should be used.

transferType.title: Transfertype
transferType.description: Destination type. Defaults to `phone`, matching agent-server runtime. `operator` routes to a live human operator via the takeover handoff control plane (warm-only; `transferTo` is a display label).

name.title: Name
name.description: SIP header name. Must start with `X-`, be 3-128 characters, match `X-[A-Za-z0-9-]+`, and must not use reserved system headers.

value.title: Value
value.description: SIP header value. Must be 1-256 characters and must not contain CR/LF or control characters other than TAB.

TransferAgentTool.description:
Built-in transfer_agent tool config.

v3 §2.7 exposes the destination as a nested ``AgentMapping``. The same
object shape is used by flow transferAgent nodes and other v3 surfaces so
clients can configure agent handoff consistently.

AgentMapping.description:
agent_id + agent_version 매핑.

요청·응답 모두에서 에이전트 매핑이 필요한 경우 이 타입을 사용한다.
요청 중 version 지정이 불필요한 엔드포인트는 flat `agent_id: UUID` 를 직접 받고,
`AgentMapping` 을 쓰지 않는다.

agent_version.description: 에이전트 버전. 허용값: "current", "production", 또는 "v{n}" (n≥1). 미전송 시 "current"로 처리됩니다. null 전송은 거부.
